## Documentation

Contains information about a star gift attribute.

### Parameters

- **`type`** ([`GiftAttributeType`](../../enums/GiftAttributeType.md))
  Type of the attribute.

- **`name`** (`str`, *optional*)
  Name of the attribute.

- **`rarity`** (`int`, *optional*)
  Rarity of the attribute in permilles.
  For example, 15 means 1.5%. So only 1.5% of such collectibles have this attribute.
  None if Telegram describes the rarity only as a tier (uncommon, rare, epic or legendary), see *rarity_type*.

- **`date`** (`datetime`, *optional*)
  Date when the gift was received.
  Available only if the original details are available.

- **`caption`** (`str`, *optional*)
  Text message.
  Available only if the original details are available.

- **`caption_entities`** (List of [`MessageEntity`](../messages_and_media/MessageEntity.md), *optional*)
  For text messages, special entities like usernames, URLs, bot commands, etc. that appear in the text.
  Available only if the original details are available.

- **`from_user`** ([`User`](../user_and_chats/User.md), *optional*)
  User who sent the gift.
  Available only if the original details are available.

- **`to_user`** ([`User`](../user_and_chats/User.md), *optional*)
  User who received the gift.
  Available only if the original details are available.

- **`center_color`** (`int`, *optional*)
  Center color of the gift in decimal format.
  Available only if the backdrop attribute is available.

- **`edge_color`** (`int`, *optional*)
  Edge color of the gift in decimal format.
  Available only if the backdrop attribute is available.

- **`pattern_color`** (`int`, *optional*)
  Pattern color of the gift in decimal format.
  Available only if the backdrop attribute is available.

- **`text_color`** (`int`, *optional*)
  Text color of the gift in decimal format.
  Available only if the backdrop attribute is available.

- **`sticker`** ([`Sticker`](../messages_and_media/Sticker.md), *optional*)
  Information about the sticker.

- **`rarity_type`** ([`GiftAttributeRarityType`](../../enums/GiftAttributeRarityType.md), *optional*)
  Type of the rarity of the attribute: `PER_MILLE` if the
  rarity is given in permilles in *rarity*, otherwise the rarity tier (uncommon, rare, epic or legendary).
  Not available for the original details attribute.

- **`is_crafted`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  True, if the model can be obtained only through gift crafting.
  Available only if the model attribute is available.
